notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome) throughout; no block encountered. robots.txt (User-agent: *) disallows only dynamic endpoints (search, cart, Product-Show, Page-Include etc), no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot-specific disallow, so tier (c) was never needed. TREE: built from union of (1) sitemap_index.xml -> sitemap_3-category.xml (181 unique category paths after normalizing locale/country-code duplicates en/nl/be/lu), (2) the site-wide 'Refine by Category' panel rendered on every PLP (this panel enumerates the full live top-nav tree: New Collection, Home Decor [Vases, Candle holders, Decoration, Mirrors, Plant pots], Tableware [aunty, Grandpa, Mugs and cups, Bowls, Plates, Glasses, Jugs, Jars, Decoration], Furniture [Stools, Chairs, Lounge, Coffee Tables, Side Tables, Tables, Cabinets, Pillars], Lighting, Design Collabs, Gifting, Online Sample Sale), and (3) sitemap_0-product.xml (1500+ product URLs) grepped for textile/storage keywords (cushion, rug, curtain, basket, storage, throw, blanket, towel, duvet, pillow, linen, napkin, placemat, tablecloth, plus Dutch 'kussen'/'tapijt') to catch orphaned products not reachable via nav. Confirmed /en/textile/ and /en/storage/ (guessed slugs) both silently 301-redirect to unrelated live pages (home-decor and furniture/cabinets respectively) per the brief's bad-slug warning - neither is a real current category. QTY: category pages render an explicit 'It looks like we can't find what you're looking for' zero-result state when cgid has no merchandised products; this was treated as an explicit qty=0 (not an estimate). No category on this site currently shows a nonzero total for any textile or storage node. EXCLUDED: all 'fabric-*'/'stof-*'/'swatch-*' sitemap nodes (breadcrumb 'Fabric options per model') are empty upholstery-swatch pickers for furniture customization, not sellable textile products - excluded. 'Bakkie Basket Lace - L' (metal decorative bowl, no live category, Material=Metal) - excluded, decorative object not fabric/storage. 'Lilly Napkin Holder' (metal napkin holder, no live category) - excluded, it holds napkins but is not itself a textile product nor a storage product. 'Grandpa Jar' family under Tableware>Jars (New Bone China Porcelain, food-safe dinnerware line) - excluded per storage.md Sec26, decorative/dining porcelain jar, not marketed as storage. Home Decor's Vases/Candle holders/Decoration/Mirrors/Plant pots and all Tableware/Furniture/Lighting nodes - excluded as Decorative Home Accessories/Kitchen & Dining/Furniture/Lighting, outside Textile+Storage scope. No Storage-qualifying node of any kind (no baskets, boxes, organizers, racks, shelving) was found anywhere on the site.
